verdict.rationale: Termius documents user-triggered automation: snippets run on demand across hosts, startup snippets run on connect, and workspace templates restore saved layouts. It also syncs cloud instances and records session logs automatically. None of these is a scheduled, recurring, or autonomous background automation that runs without the user initiating a session, and the community monitoring use relies on the user's own scripts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
